left.raw_text:
Inclusion Criteria:
  -  Participants were eligible for inclusion in the study if they had evidence suggesting acute ischemic stroke that lasted for ≤ 4
-  Those Participants were treated with intravenous thrombolytic therapy ((recombinant tissue plasminogen activator (rt-PA))

right.raw_text:
Exclusion Criteria:
  -  Those who had hemorrhagic stroke
  -  participants presented with acute myocardial infarction, [OR]  cerebrovascular stroke in the previous three months

left.raw_text: -  serious head trauma in the previous three months

right.raw_text: -  urinary tract, [OR]  lung, [OR]  or gastrointestinal hemorrhage within the three weeks

left.raw_text: -  serious trauma  [OR] or major surgery within the previous two weeks

right.raw_text: -  lumbar  [OR] or arterial puncture at a non-compressible site within one week

left.raw_text: -  those received heparin within 48 hours, resulting in an activated partial thromboplastin time greater than the upper limit of normal

right.raw_text: -  systolic pressure  [OR] > 185 mmHg or diastolic pressure > 110 mmHg
-  current use of anticoagulants  [AND] with an International Normalized Ratio  [OR] > 1

left.raw_text: 7 or prothrombin time>15 sec; platelet count < 100,000/mm3

right.raw_text: -  pregnancy; serious heart, [OR]  lung, [OR]  kidney  [OR] or other organ dysfunction

left.raw_text: -  allergy to active ingredients of rt-PA; patients with > 4
5 hours from the last time known to be asymptomatic

right.raw_text: -  those in whom troponin was not measured at admission were excluded from the study
